objective: Deliver Magatha's Note to Jediga in Azshara.

description: Take this note to Jediga. Tell her the payment will be here for her when she returns. And tell her I am pleased with her work.
Go swiftly, <name>. Tell your master I will be awaiting her here.
progress: Well, what did Magatha say? The old crone... I bet she was less than polite.
completion: Ah, good. She was much more reasonable than I expected... at least towards you. I half expected her to have you punished for my insolence in sending someone in my place. She must really want that tablet. Interesting.
